lightSearchRecord.ratingFields: [4][7] rating, [4][8] review count (for 方向二 lifetime vs recent: recent needs the DOM review scrape, scraper.ts, newest sort)

detailRecord.175_featuredReviews: Only ~10 reviews (8–15, ~2–5k chars) incl. owner replies/translations; ~1 of 10 mentions any template keyword → too thin for review-based templates at area scale. Review entries: arrays whose [0][0] is a 'Ci…' review id; path 175.7.0.0 on ハース池袋.
detailRecord.153_topics: dish-centric (ガレット:212, 席:71, デート:17, 学生証:8) — occasionally useful (席, 個室, 子供) but not reliable for templates.
detailRecord.reviewSearchEndpoint: The Maps UI review search (クチコミを検索) could not be captured: /maps/rpc/listugcposts replied 403 to hand-built pb; the UI's own call was not visible to fetch/XHR hooks, performance entries or the network tool (only batchexecute qv9Egd logging). NOT usable. Alternatives: the [142] snippet via Maps search (area), or the DOM review scrape on the open place (scraper.ts).

nano.intentToTemplate: 32/32 correct (zh/ja/en free text → enum of 8 templates + none), 1.7–3.5 s each, responseConstraint enum, expectedInputs ja/en (zh NOT accepted as expectedInputs language, zh text still works).
nano.intentCases: 一個人吃不尷尬→solo, 有插座可以工作兩小時→work, 小孩哭也不會被瞪→kids, 輪椅進得去→wheelchair, 素食者有主餐→vegetarian, my parents don't speak Japanese→english_menu, 可以用 Suica 付→cashless, 終電後に食べられる→late_night, 便宜的午餐/犬同伴OK/要停車/禁煙の店→none
nano.snippetJudge_work: Template 'work' on 20 [142] snippets of 池袋 電源 カフェ + 5 synthetic controls. Keyword snippets (電源/充電/PC作業): 8 yes with exact quotes (全席電源がある, 電源も多数あり, 席ごとに電源タップ, 充電できるソファ席, パソコン作業している人などもいて), 1 unsure (PRONTO 電源席の増設が必要 — right call). Non-keyword snippets: 11/11 unsure (no false positives). Controls: 電源はありません→no, コンセントは使えない→no, 騒がしかった→no, 美味しくて親切→unsure, 電源ドリルの音→no. 4–6 s per prompt alone (12–18 s while another Nano job shared the queue). Add 充電/PC作業/パソコン to the keyword gate.
nano.fullReviewJudge_work: Same question with ALL featured reviews of 6 ランチ places (2–4k chars): 5 unsure, 1 no (キッチンABC: 行列/回転), 8–18 s each; quotes on 'unsure' are sometimes not in the input → only trust quotes on yes/no (same gate as nanoLunch.ts).

conclusion.tierA_attributes: solo, kids, wheelchair, vegetarian/vegan/halal, cashless (PayPay/IC/card vs 現金のみ), quiet(静か), late_night(深夜の食事可 + hours), wifi, private room, dog OK, non-smoking: all deterministic from the LIGHT search record → whole area in 1–2 requests, no Nano.
conclusion.tierB_snippets: work(電源/コンセント/Wi-Fi), kids (子連れ), vegetarian (ヴィーガン) can ALSO be found via Maps keyword search + [142] snippet + keyword gate + Nano polarity judge + quote-in-input gate.
conclusion.notFeasibleAtAreaScale: english_menu (no attribute, weak keyword, category drift) → place-page only (DOM review scrape). 'not awkward alone' nuance → use attribute 一人での食事 + カウンター席.

harness_2026-10-31.$comment: scripts/ask-harness.ts on 池袋 @35.7295,139.7125,17z, one template at a time, round 0 queries (3 queries x 2 pages of 100), memory stores. kw = places whose [142] quote matches the template keyword. Nano ms = per judgment.

cashless.note: weak filter: most places take some cashless payment; value is flagging the cash-only ones

date.review: 18 judgments all reasonable; 2 were parks (南池袋公園, 池袋西口公園) → FOOD_PLACE category gate added

chat.review: reasonable; borderline: 永坂更科 'customers chat too much' → no

vegetarian.review: yes when a review says the place accommodated a vegetarian/vegan; partial cases unsure; vague + quote-not-in-input gates fired

outlet.speed: ~4 s per judgment → ~5 min for 82 keyword places in one area

compound_conditions_2026-11-01.$comment: Can one request carry several conditions (安靜的約會 = date + quiet)? 池袋 @35.7295,139.7125,17z, hl=ja.

R1_attribute_modifiers.sample: 522 places from レストラン/カフェ/居酒屋/バー/イタリアン/和食 (100 each)

R2_compound_query_snippets.$comment: 40 results per query; a = modifier keyword in the [142] quote, b = base keyword, both = both
R2_compound_query_snippets.finding: Maps picks the quote for the more specific word (the modifier); one quote rarely covers both → answer each condition separately and intersect, don't expect one sentence to prove a compound.

R3_multi_aspect_nano.cases: 12 crafted sentences with known date/quiet labels (all yes/no/unsure combos)
R3_multi_aspect_nano.one_prompt_two_aspects: 10/12 both right, 1.6 s/place; errors: 'パスタが美味しい' → date yes (false positive), 'ワイワイ' → quiet unsure
R3_multi_aspect_nano.two_prompts_one_aspect: 10/12 both right, 2.0 s/place; errors: 'BGMが大きくて会話がしづらい' → date no, '静かすぎて…デートには微妙' → quiet no
R3_multi_aspect_nano.finding: same accuracy, one prompt ~20% faster; keep the per-aspect quote/keyword gate either way

R4_intent_vocabulary.flat_20 (10 bases + 10 modifiers): 17/20, 1.5 s: drops the base (安靜可以讀書 → quiet only; おしゃれな雰囲気のデート → mood only), confuses chat/groups
R4_intent_vocabulary.structured purpose + ≤2 modifiers: purpose 19/20 (only any/none mix-up) incl. every compound; modifiers over-added 3/20 (作業→lively, 午餐→casual, 蛋糕→quiet), 1.3 s
R4_intent_vocabulary.fix: structured schema + a deterministic cue gate per modifier (modifier kept only if its word appears in the sentence, e.g. quiet needs 安靜|靜|静か|落ち着|quiet)

place_types_2026-11-01.intent: 37–38 sentences (scripts/intent-harness.ts). Nano with a `type` field: added a type the sentence never named in 9/37 (ラーメン ×4, カフェ ×2 …), after a stricter prompt in 17/37 (copied the last shot's バー, even 要停車 → bar). → type comes from the word table only (latest-ending match wins: 法式甜點 → sweets); Nano prompt unchanged. Final run: 36/38 (misses: 便宜的燒肉 → Nano adds lunch; 吃點日本料理以外的 → negation → washoku). Words added from Nano's two good guesses: bare 麵/麺 → ramen, 喝一杯/喝酒 → bar.
place_types_2026-11-01.queries: With a type, other questions' searches are aimed: '静か カフェ' → '静か 居酒屋', 'レストラン' → 'ラーメン', type-named queries of another type dropped (ワインバー with 拉麵), keywords get the noun ('ベジタリアン ラーメン'); a query runs once, empty rounds skipped.
